exposure: thinning of the hyperechogenic uterine serosa-bladder wall interface
abnormal blood vessels at the myometrium-bladder interface
loss of normal hypoechoic retroplacental myometrial space
cohort: Pregnant patients with Caesarean scar and placenta praevia in the third trimester of pregnancy
finding: Antenatal ultrasound is a useful tool in predicting placenta accreta in high-risk patients.
